What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Grace advised Lily to try cooking as a new hobby. Little by little, things began to change. Also, the cattle graze on the hill all day.

Lily thanked Grace for the honest advice. Lily believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Lily will take part in a basketball match in September. Also, a&E was busy at midnight.

Grace always says that small steps matter more than big plans. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. People around Lily often share different ideas about the camping site. For example, the popularity of the cafe grew after it appeared on TV.
